title: The Finite Spring Finale
premise: A maker wants a toy theater to run forever on one wound spring, but the scene slows after each cycle. A cutaway shows the finite winding unwinding; the maker adds a visible audience hand crank and relabels the show HELP KEEP IT GOING, turning failure into participation.
hook: The machine works forever. Until now.
visible_action: Spring unwinds; stage carousel slows; winding indicator reaches zero; an external crank appears; audience turns it and the scene resumes.
intended_takeaway_or_theme: Show the input that keeps a mechanism moving.
gate: The energy-accounting lesson requires primary physics-source review before publication. Avoid numerical efficiency claims or treating this stylized model as a validated device.

editorial_pick.original_reason: A finite spring mechanism creates a built-in ending and a useful limit to the action.
editorial_pick.proposed_first_version: Show the stored-motion setup, a short sequence of consequences and the calm state after the energy is spent.
editorial_pick.gate: Keep it a fictional prop. If making real mechanics claims, validate the energy accounting and safe boundaries.
